title: Vice-President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan to visit Varanasi on November 28
subtitle: Vice-President to grace inaugural ceremony of Kashi Tamil Sangamam 5.0
body_text: The Vice-President of India, Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan, will visit Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, on Saturday, November 28, 2026, to grace the inaugural ceremony of Kashi Tamil Sangamam 5.0, an initiative celebrating the age-old cultural and civilisational bonds between Kashi and Tamil Nadu, reflecting the spirit of Ek Bharat, Shreshtha Bharat . During his visit, the Vice-President will also offer prayers at the Shri Kaal Bhairav Temple and Shri Kashi Vishwanath Temple in Varanasi. *** PR/ASM/VMJ
